name: Inner Line Permit — Adi Kailash / Om Parvat / Kuti Valley route
requirement: Permits for this route are issued at Dharchula and a medical check-up is conducted there. Om Parvat lies in a restricted border zone and an Inner Line Permit is required for access.
sourceSentence: The permits for this route are issued at Dharchula and medical check-up is conducted there.

name: Valley of Flowers National Park entry permit
requirement: Visitors need a permit from the Forest Department at Ghangaria; one can get it directly at the check-post, no need to apply prior.
sourceName: Wikipedia (English) — Valley of Flowers National Park / Joshimath
sourceSentence: Visitors to the Valley of Flowers need to get a permit from the Forest Department, at Ghangaria.

name: Nanda Devi National Park trekking permit
requirement: The DFO Joshimath issues permits for trekking inside the park. The Nanda Devi core (inner) zone has been closed to regular trekking under UNESCO protections — only limited sanctioned activity.
officialSource: Divisional Forest Officer, Joshimath (per Wikipedia documentation)
sourceSentence: The DFO Joshimath issues permits for trekking inside the park.

name: Jim Corbett National Park safari permit (day visit / night stay)
requirement: Safari permits are issued online (eCorbett) or at the CTR Reception Office in Ramnagar. Only licensed local gypsy vehicles with registered drivers may enter; visitors must carry the same ID submitted at booking. Permits are non-refundable once confirmed.
documents: Aadhaar / DL / PAN / Voter ID / Passport (foreigners)
Same ID must be carried during safari
officialSource: Corbett Tiger Reserve / Uttarakhand Forest Department
sourceSentence: Permits are issued at the CTR Reception Office in Ramnagar.

name: Char Dham Yatra registration (Yamunotri, Gangotri, Kedarnath, Badrinath + Hemkund Sahib)
requirement: Registration is compulsory for pilgrims on the Char Dham Yatra and Hemkund Sahib. Available online via the official Tourist Care portal, via the Tourist Care mobile app, WhatsApp (+91 8394833833), and offline counters at Haridwar/Rishikesh and en route.
documents: Aadhaar / Voter ID / Passport / Driving Licence
